mechanism: Phenytoin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that significantly reduces dronedarone plasma concentrations, thereby decreasing antiarrhythmic efficacy; concurrent use also increases risk of phenytoin toxicity if dronedarone inhibits its metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if unavoidable, monitor dronedarone efficacy closely (ECG, arrhythmia control) and consider alternative antiarrhythmic agents not affected by enzyme induction.
